newsitem.title: ESTONIA: STOCKS MIXED IN SLOW TRADE.
newsitem.headline: STOCKS MIXED IN SLOW TRADE.

text.p: * The total bourse turnover at 0800 GMT was 8.9 million
kroons on Thursday morning.
* The Talse online index lost 0.07 percent to 252.30.
* Tallinna Pank was the most active stock with
2.1 million kroons turned over to gain 60.80/61.30 kroons
versus 60.25 kroons.
* Hansapank turned over 1.8 million kroons to be
traded lower at 129.65/130 kroons compared to 130.75 kroons.
* Dealers said stocks have been mixed this morning with no
clear trend. No big changes in closing prices are expected.
Trade on the Tallinn bourse was
slow on Thursday morning and stocks were mixed though demand
was seen for Tallinna Pank and Hoiupank ,
dealers said.
Tallinna Pank was the most active stock with 2.1 million
kroons turned over to gain slightly higher.
Dealers said investors think the stock is comparatively
cheap.
Trade in Hoiupank was relatively active again and the price
continued to rise, dealers said.
"Hoiupank is clearly moving upwards," a dealer said, adding
that one investor was behind most of the demand.
Farmaatsiatehas was traded higher at
117.75/118.50 kroons versus 117.05 kroons.
Dealers said the market is still positive about
Farmaatsiatehas, which announced earlier this week that it had
reached an agreement to reduce tariffs on its imports to Russia
and is expected to approve a revised profit estimate on Monday.
The closing prices are expected to remain stable, dealers
said, adding that Hoiupank and Tallinna Pank might give some
stability to the market.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn Newsroom, +372 630 8400,
reuters@reuters.ee
